title: Candidate Pulse + Shadow Onboarding Kit
summary: Practical, lightweight kit to run a 14-day accelerated onboarding that pairs a structured interview evidence rubric with a short candidate pulse survey and a 'shadow rotation' for new ICs. Goal is faster ramp + consistent interviewer signal capture + early cross-team alignment.
goals:
- Reduce time-to-contribution for individual ICs by focusing first 14 days on context and relationship building.
- Normalize interview evidence capture across hiring panels.
- Provide an asynchronous candidate pulse to catch early friction.
- Enable rapid calibration of hiring managers via a short interviewer checklist and a single consolidated scorecard.
quick_hiring_plan:
1) Role brief (owner: hiring manager) due T-7 days: responsibilities, 3 mission metrics, must-have skills.
2) Interview cohort (owner: recruiter) T-6: assign panel, share evidence rubric and 20-minute calibration video.
3) Interview week (owner: interviewers): use evidence-first rubric; record 3 example answers in notes.
4) Debrief + scorecard (owner: hiring manager): 48 hours after last interview.
5) Offer decision + 14-day onboarding schedule sent with 'shadow rotation' plan and pulse link.
Owners: hiring manager, recruiter, people-ops coordinator. Timing: from open to offer 2–3 weeks target for IC roles where feasible.
interview_rubric:
Overview: evidence-first scoring (0-4) across 5 axes. Interviewers should capture 1–2 concrete examples per axis.
Axes and anchors:
- Technical competence (0=no relevant exposure, 2=can solve medium tasks with guidance, 4=independently designs/optimizes systems)
- Product sense / tradeoffs (0=cannot articulate tradeoffs, 2=identifies tradeoffs with some gaps, 4=drives product decisions balancing metrics)
- Collaboration & communication (0=unclear, 2=works well with peers, 4=leads cross-team alignment)
- Problem-solving approach (0=no structured approach, 2=uses heuristics with reasoning, 4=structured decomposition + measurable outcomes)
- Culture & values alignment (Redwood values sample anchors: ownership, reliability, developer empathy)
Scoring guidance: 0-1 = do not advance, 2 = consider with reservations, 3 = strong candidate, 4 = clear hire.
Notes: prefer short bullet evidence rather than adjectives. Call out any unknowns as 'risks' in the scorecard.

onboarding_checklist:
Pre-boarding (T-3 to T+0):
- Send welcome packet + 1 pager: team mission, 3 center-of-excellence docs, primary SLAs.
- Provision accounts (eng infra, Slack, base infra) and invite to team calendar.
- Assign mentor and shadow rotation schedule.
Day 0-2: Orientation & systems
- Day 0: 90-minute team intro; 30-minute meet-and-greet w/ direct manager; setup dev environment checklist.
- Day 1: Shadow rotation kickoff with 1-hour orientation to each team they'll shadow (product, infra, ops); share first-week small task.
Week 1 (days 3-7): Shadow rotation in practice
- Shadow A (product): observe planning/roadmap sync, take notes on how decisions are made.
- Shadow B (infra): observe incident triage + runbook walkthrough.
- Shadow C (sre/platform): observe deployment + monitoring handoff.
- End-of-week 1: 30-minute 'pulse' check-in (from people-ops) + 1-page reflection saved to shared drive.
Week 2 (days 8-14): Gradual ownership + small deliverable
- Pair on a small, scoped ticket with mentor.
- 1:1 weekly cadence with manager established; set 30/60/90 draft.
- End-of-week 2: demo of small deliverable; feedback loop with hiring manager and mentor.
Ongoing onboarding rituals:
- Weekly mentor 1:1 for first 90 days.
- Biweekly learning share where new hire presents 'what I learned' after first month.
mentor_sync_schedule:
Mentor: schedule five 30-minute touchpoints in first 14 days.
- Day 0 (welcome + expectations)
- Day 2 (environment and blockers)
- Day 5 (first impressions + learning plan)
- Day 9 (deliverable pairing)
- Day 14 (handoff + 30/60/90 draft review)
Mentor responsibilities: own small-task pairing, clear feedback at each touchpoint, surface escalations to hiring manager within 48 hours.
candidate_pulse_template:
Short async survey (3 questions) to run on day 7 and day 14: 
1) How clear were role expectations? (1-5)
2) What friction did you encounter in tooling/onboarding? (short text)
3) One thing that would make the next week better? (short text)
People-ops review cadence: aggregate weekly, auto-flag responses with low score for manager follow-up within 48 hours.
unresolved_questions:
- Should the shadow rotation be mandatory for senior ICs? tradeoff: time vs cross-team context.
- Do managers want the candidate pulse anonymized when sent internally?
- Where should reflection docs live long-term (team vs central onboarding drive)?
notes_to_self: This kit is intentionally opinionated: short, synchronous touchpoints + asynchronous pulse. Pilot on two upcoming backend IC hires in Nov 2025 and gather metrics: ramp-to-first-PR, survey-sentiment, interviewer calibration variance.
